description: UNOSAT Geospatial Data on Floods in Mozambique - March 2019 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This data illustrates the satellite detected surface waters in Manica, Sofala, and Tete Provinces in Mozambique, as observed from Sentinel-1 imagery acquired on 13, 14, 19 and 20 March 2019. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
